purpose: Accordion row: question button with a plus/minus icon, answer panel that animates height and opacity.

answer.note: BODY COPY: answer paragraphs; measured total per item 9-91 words, up to 4 paragraphs (b on pricing/links/distribution/consumer-platforms; c on the other 9). Budget total 95 words.

states.collapsed: default for every item (height 0, opacity 0, overflow-hidden)
states.transition: 300ms cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.35,1) on height and opacity (height starts one frame after opacity)

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule (the site has no prefers-reduced-motion handling): toggle height/opacity instantly (0ms) instead of tweening.

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract
evidence.copy: b on 4 pages, c on 9; no FAQ on / or /product/coda-giftcloud/
